description: This is a Java source file for a Spring MVC Controller class named StoreLandingController, handling administrative store landing page display and save functionalities in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: StoreLandingController
classes.description: Controller handling store landing page display and updates in the admin UI.

methods.name: displayStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store landing page editing interface, loads existing content or initializes new descriptions for each language.

methods.name: saveStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update the store landing page content, including descriptions for multiple languages.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up the navigation menu and active menu indicators in the UI.
